title: Phino
summary: A Flutter app that shares files between nearby Android phones over Wi-Fi, with no internet connection needed.
details: Discovers devices on the same local network
Built as an open source project

title: Telephony simulation platform
summary: An event-driven simulator for learning how distributed systems behave, modeled on how phone networks route and connect calls.
details: Models calls as events moving between services
Lets you test failures and retries safely
Designed as a hands-on learning tool
